sources.evidence: 本文h1、試合前／今季平均EFF、リーグ別のベスト5、および選出ルール・注記を確認。2026-10-31 03:02 JST時点で試合前。当日EFFは公式記録確定待ち。対象試合の登録選手を今季平均EFFでリーグ別に選出し、出場は保証しない。
HTMLと同じ記事本文・対象日・今季平均の選出条件・出場保証なしの留保を確認。本文の根拠はこのTXTと固定HTMLだけ。

person_reference.reason: 単独の人物が主役ではないリーグ別の登録選手選出記事。人物・顔・手を描かず、ボールとコートのイラストで構成。

brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail as a PNG, landscape 16:9, 1792x1024 or preferably 1920x1080, at least 1000 pixels wide. This is the final designed image including all typography, not a mockup.

Style: approved バスケまとめ editorial look: near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B, warm ivory lettering and a single orange basketball. Expressive hand-ink illustration, dry-brush streaks, subtle paper grain and ink flecks. Bold Japanese gothic headlines with confident spacing, very few visual elements, crisp readable typography. No photographic appearance.

Article facts for the design only: games on 2026-10-31 have not started in the fixed manuscript. The article selects registered players separately for B.PREMIER, B.ONE and B.NEXT by this season's average EFF. It is not a ranking of actual performances that day. Selection does not guarantee participation. There is no single featured person.

Composition: generous 5% safe margins on all sides. Left approximately 63% is a clear typography block. Right approximately 33% contains ONE beautifully ink-drawn orange basketball with black curved seams in front of a few ivory half-court lines, with one dynamic diagonal lime brush stroke behind it. All main text is on a calm dark field. The ball should feel like a graphic symbol of basketball, not a depiction of a particular play. Do not draw people, faces, hands, jerseys, team emblems, sponsors, scoreboards, trophy or rankings/chart elements. The central Japanese headline has immense visual impact, with the number 5 especially large and lime colored but fully on-canvas. Avoid busy decoration.

Render ONLY these exact text strings, with these roles and hierarchy:
Top left small brand: "バスケまとめ"
Upper tag, clearly readable: "10/31 試合前"
Main headline line 1 in large ivory bold Japanese: "登録選手の"
Main headline line 2 in huge bold Japanese, strongest hierarchy: "ベスト5"
Supporting line, readable: "今季平均EFFでリーグ別に選出"
League line, slightly smaller: "B.PREMIER / B.ONE / B.NEXT"
Visible qualification below: "出場は保証されません"
Bottom footer small but legible with adequate bottom margin, on two separate lines:
"イラスト（AI生成）"
"成績をもとにしたイメージ"

Do not add any other words or numbers. Do not carry over a player's name, points, game scores or date from unrelated style examples. Do not claim a match result, confirmed lineup or actual game scene. Precisely spell all Japanese and all league names. No text overlap and no cropped typography. Deliver one premium finished thumbnail.

style_reference.usage: 配色・太字見出し・インクとブラシの描画を参照。選手名・数値・人物は流用していない。

qa_observations.text_and_numbers: 生成画像と保存PNGを目視し、全9行の文言、10/31、ベスト5、EFF、3リーグ名に誤字・欠字がないことを確認。試合結果や個人の成績値は掲載していない。
qa_observations.source_qualifiers: 試合前、今季平均EFFでリーグ別に選出、出場は保証されませんが実際の画像内に明記されている。当日の結果や先発確定を示す表現はない。
qa_observations.likeness_or_no_named_person: 人物・顔・手・選手名は描写されていない。特定試合の場面を創作していない。
qa_observations.layout: 約16:9。見出し・日付・留保・AI表記が画面内に収まり、文字同士やボールとの重なり・見切れはない。黒地・ライム・アイボリー・オレンジのコントラストと読みやすさを目視確認。
qa_observations.ai_label: 左下にイラスト（AI生成）と成績をもとにしたイメージの2行を確認。
